C09122911500.summary: Chief of Staff Ōyama in Osaka to Lt-Gen. Terauchi: until he returns to the capital, Terauchi is asked to handle the business of the General Staff (本職帰京迄本部ノ事務ハ貴官宜シク取計ハレタシ).
C09122911500.en: Until I return to the capital, I ask Your Excellency kindly to manage the business of the General Staff.

C09123116600.summary: A request from Kokura to Maj.-Gen. Iguchi of the General Staff for the loan of the needed maps of Korea (要用ノ韓国地図貸与サレタシ); the reply draft in the same file sends maps of Korea.

C09122909900.summary: Ōyama in Osaka to Maj.-Gen. Fukushima about observing the naval exercise (カイグン…エンシウケンガク).

C03020059400.summary: Division commander Inoue to the War Minister, Jan 1904: the NCOs, men, equipment and materials needed by Anchorage Command Shin (辛碇泊場司令部, the enciphered words) have been handed to the head of the Moji branch supply depot, who will report completion directly. Read with the contemporary translation filed with it (frame 0118).
C03020059400.en:
To the Minister, from Division commander Inoue. The NCOs and men and the equipment and materials needed by Anchorage
Command Shin have been handed over to the head of the Moji branch supply depot. The completion of […] is to be
reported directly by the head of the branch depot.

snip.cap: Osaka, 27 March 1902: Oyama to Terauchi, the whole telegram in digit pairs
snip.credit: National Institute for Defense Studies, 参謀本部 雑 秘 明治35年 電報綴 北清事件, frame 0110, via JACAR Ref. C09122911500

system: Each kana is two digits on a coordinate table: vowel row (a0 i1 u2 e3 o4, +5 voiced) then consonant column in reverse gojuon order (a9 ka8 ... wa0), n = 10.
